text: Lancaster Colony decided to exit the Bantam Bagels business, which it had acquired for $34 million in October 2018, resulting in a noncash restructuring and impairment charge of $22.7 million.
Family Dollar ceased shipments from and is closing an Arkansas warehouse due to a rodent infestation that affected food and nutrition products.
Brace's Bakery is closing its factory as part of a business reset.
Tesco is closing its Snodland distribution centre in Kent, with all 520 staff members being offered roles at a new distribution centre in Aylesford.
Kellanov is closing its Manchester factory with 360 expected job losses.
Saputo plans to close six facilities in the United States.
Cereal Partners Worldwide suspended operations in Russia following the country's invasion of Ukraine.
Unilever will close two factories in Long Island, New York, laying off 169 manufacturing employees.
Saputo is ending production of ingredients for infant-formula products at its Davidstow Creamery, putting 60 jobs at risk.
The company experienced an abrupt factory closure in 2022.

The Abbott Nutrition Factory in Sturgis, Michigan was subject to an FDA investigation following infant deaths potentially tied to formula recalls, revealing on-site safety issues including standing water and lack of proper sanitation.
J.M. Smucker will close its liquid coffee facility in Suffolk, Virginia in spring 2022, resulting in 80 job losses.
Kellanov plans to close its Manchester factory, which employs 360 workers, before the end of 2026.
Unilever sold its Russian business including four factories in the country.
PepsiCo's proposed restructure of UK operations puts over 500 jobs at risk, including around 250 at its Walkers crisps manufacturing site in Leicester.
Young's Seafood proposes closing its Marsden Road whitefish processing facility in Grimsby, with operations to be transferred to other sites.
Saputo confirmed plans to close its King Island Dairy operation in Australia by mid-2025, impacting 58 employees.
Pilgrim's Food Masters plans to close its manufacturing site in Dean Way, Southall, resulting in approximately 260 redundancies.
Sedamyl is investing £80m to expand its Selby plant to increase potable alcohol capacity and begin production of liquid sweeteners.
Seabrook Crisps is increasing output by 70% with a £12 million investment in its Bradford facility.
Rise Baking Co. acquired Dawn Foods' North American frozen manufacturing business, including four plants and their workforce.
Lactalis converted a 33,150 square-foot production facility in Sudbury, Ontario into a fully operational dedicated plant-based manufacturing facility.
PepsiCo is expanding the existing Killingly manufacturing facility and warehouse while adding two new Cheetos snacks manufacturing lines.
Princes Foods installed a new canning line at its Long Sutton facility capable of filling up to 3 million cans per week, increasing overall production capacity by more than 10%.
Conagra Brands invested in its tomato processing plant to upgrade software and streamline supply chain operations, with plans to boost tomato production by 25%.
Kraft Heinz will invest in its UK factory in Kitt Green to expand production to include Heinz-branded sauces such as tomato ketchup, mayonnaise, and salad cream.
Chobani is investing $567 million in La Colombe's Norton Shores, Michigan plant to expand the brand's growth and production capacity.
The company upgraded its production capacity by over 40% through investment in new fully automated bakery line and modernised equipment.
Chobani is investing $567 million in La Colombe's Norton Shores manufacturing plant to expand the brand's production capacity and growth.
Chobani is investing $567 million in La Colombe's Norton Shores manufacturing facility to expand the brand's growth and production capacity.
Quevos expanded its manufacturing facility from 10,000 square feet to 32,000 square feet and brought in more efficient equipment.
Smucker is expanding production facilities for Uncrustables frozen sandwiches in Longmont, Colorado, with completion expected in the back half of fiscal 2023.
Chobani invested $567 million in La Colombe's Norton Shores, Michigan plant to expand the brand's growth and production capacity.
Danone invested €15m ($15.8m) in a factory expansion in Turkey for medical nutrition products.

Bay State Milling acquired full ownership of Montana Gluten Free Processors LLC's processing facility in Belgrade, Montana, expanding its operations to 13 milling, processing, lab and commercial facilities across the United States and Canada.
PepsiCo is investing $200 million to expand its Frito-Lay plant by adding two new manufacturing lines for Funyuns and tortilla chips and increasing warehouse capacity.
Kraft Heinz launched TruffVels, a limited-time chocolate and cheese truffle created in collaboration with Compartés Chocolatier, featuring a white chocolate shell infused with Velveeta.
Snack a Jacks launched a new Lightly Salted Caramel flavor in its Minis range, available in 80g Grazing Bags and multipacks starting October 13.
Oatly launched Oatmilk Creamers in four flavors (Sweet & Creamy, Vanilla, Caramel, and Mocha) available in grocery stores nationwide across North America.
Fairfields Farm launched a new limited-edition Chorizo & Red Wine crisp flavour in 150g sharing packs.
Sanpellegrino launched a new 'Zero Added Sugar' range in the UK market.
Once Upon a Farm launched three new organic product lines for babies and children featuring meat, meat and bone broth, and legume blends with at least 4 grams of protein per pouch.
PepsiCo launched Mtn Dew Rise Energy, a new line of energy drinks.

McVitie's launched multiple new biscuit products in summer 2024 including Jaffa Cakes Cola Bottle, Rich Tea The Cocoa One, Seriously Chocolatey Digestives, Gold Digestives, and a three-strong Signature range.
Mondelēz and Hershey launched Reese's Oreo Cups and Oreo Reese's Cookies, combining two iconic brands in a flavor mashup product launch.
Beatbox launched its flavoured wine beverage to the UK market with four SKUs: Blue Razzberry, Juicy Mango, Orange Blast and Fruit Punch.
Claussen debuted The Spritz Society Pickle wine cocktail, marking the brand's first beverage product to retail.
Doughlicious is unveiling a frozen cookie dough skillet line in a chocolate chip flavor.
Eden Mill launched Golf Gin with a nationwide listing across 202 Waitrose stores with three-month exclusivity.
Nestle launched ready-to-bake brownies combining cocoa and semi-sweet morsels, available in Meijer stores beginning in March 2022.
Nestlé launched Nescafé Gold Cappuccino Ice Cream, featuring real coffee in both the coating and ice cream with patented soft coating technology.

Mission Barns partnered with Silva Sausage to create and complete a scaled-up manufacturing run of Mission Chorizo Sausage, a plant protein sausage made with cultivated fat, marking the first partnership between a cultured fat company and a plant-based meat manufacturer in North America.
Simple Mills launched Cheddar Pop Mmms, a new line of snack crackers made from vegetable flour including organic butternut squash and organic red bean.
Blue Pacific Flavors introduced Kilimanjaro Vanilla, a new vanilla product with extracts produced in Tanzania.
PepsiCo's beverage division is building a new 1.2 million-square-foot manufacturing facility in Colorado with three times the capacity of the nearby facility it will replace.

General Mills broke ground on a new $12 million baking plant in Nashik, Maharashtra, which will be the company's second Pillsbury baking mix plant in India and is expected to be operational by August 2024.
Good Catch opened a custom-built factory to cement its production ability.
Gousto is building a new £40 million sustainable automated chilled fulfilment centre in Burton to increase operational capacity by 40%.
G&S Foods opened a new 348,344-square-foot snack food manufacturing plant in Hanover that consolidates production, research and development, warehousing and administrative offices into one facility.
Around Noon opened a new 30,000 sq ft manufacturing facility in Slough, which is the group's fifth manufacturing facility in the UK & Ireland and second in the South East of England.
Oats Overnight is constructing a new production site in Phoenix.
PepsiCo will build a new sustainable manufacturing plant in Poland, set to be completed by 2025, featuring solar panels and water recycling systems.
CGB Enterprises and Minnesota Soybean Processors announced a joint venture to construct a state-of-the-art soybean processing plant near Casselton, North Dakota.
Ardagh Metal Packaging is building a new $200 million metal can manufacturing plant in Northern Ireland to serve increased demand from beverage customers in Ireland, the UK and Europe.
Mackie's Crisps invested £750,000 in a new facility in Errol, Perthshire dedicated to the production of Wholesums vegetable chip snacks.

Tillamook County Creamery Association will open a new ice cream manufacturing plant in Decatur, Illinois in late 2024, the cooperative's first owned and operated facility outside of Oregon and dedicated solely to ice cream production.

Marson Foods opened a new 147,000-square-foot distribution facility and production lines in Hazelwood with automated freezer capacity, R&D capabilities, and space for five additional production lines.
A new plastic recycling plant is being constructed in Durham to process flexible packaging materials from Nestlé brands into pellets for bin bags and other products.
BioBetter opened its first food-grade pilot facility using molecular farming technology with genetically modified tobacco plants as bioreactors for producing growth factors used in cultivated meat.
Nightingale Ice Cream Sandwiches is relocating its production and corporate headquarters to a new facility in Richmond, Virginia.
Pilgrim's Pride plans to build a new multi-phase prepared foods facility in LaFayette to produce fully cooked chicken products.
Crust Craft is building a new, larger production facility in the Edmonton Metro Region that will integrate advanced baking technologies.
Outlander Materials has created technology to upcycle food waste into an alternative packaging material called Unplastic as a substitute for single-use plastics.
Bel Group is replacing biobased plastic film with paper for Babybel cheese overwraps across its five global production plants as part of sustainability efforts.
The company swapped out its Weetabix Original biscuits' packaging for a recyclable paper wrap, increasing recyclability from 90% to 100% once rollout is completed.
innocent unveiled a drinks packaging redesign featuring updates to the 'Dude' logo and integrated design elements, with rollout beginning in October 2024 and completion by February 2025.
Tom's Perfect 10 unveiled new packaging for its Ginger Zing and Classic granola flavors, along with introducing 3-oz travel bags.
Nestlé is supporting a circular economy initiative to recycle its flexible plastic packaging from Kit Kat wrappers, Purina petfood pouches, and cereal bags into new plastic products.
Willamette Valley Pie Co. completed a full packaging refresh as part of its product line updates.
Gunna Drinks introduced aluminium bottled soft drinks, claiming to be the UK's first, with aluminium being infinitely recyclable as an environmentally sustainable packaging solution.
Amazon Grocery products feature new packaging that clearly displays nutrition information, uses less plastic, and includes easy-to-read typography.
Nestle will eliminate all plastic straws from product packaging manufactured at its Eau Claire facility, removing approximately 125 million plastic straws per year.

Evian unveiled a new recycled plastic (rPET) prototype bottle using Loop Industries technology that converts all types of PET plastic waste into new bottles, with commercial rollout planned for South Korea in 2022.
Sainsbury's removed traditional plastic tray packaging from its entire beef mince range, replacing it with vacuum-packed alternative.
Vitalite updated its packaging to include a 'top 14 allergen free' claim, a clearer 'dairy-free' message replacing 'plant-based' language, and an 'Absolutely No Preservatives' claim.
Grupo Bimbo uses 30% recycled material in its bread bags in the United States.
Keurig Dr Pepper committed to cutting its use of virgin plastic by 25% by 2025.
Red Gold transitioned to Non-B.P.A./B.P.S.-lined cans for its canned tomato products.
Persil transitioned its 3 in 1 laundry capsules to plastic-free packaging in March 2023.
Mars reported that 20% of its plastic packaging is reusable, recyclable or compostable as of 2021.
